/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -c 'import hashlib, os, stat, subprocess
expected = "8a6232a6bdda526eb7c6fa6cc24990e8c53b3b899e82c292d6202399efe2a714"
env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0")
root = subprocess.check_output(["/usr/bin/git", "--no-optional-locks", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], env=env, timeout=2).decode().strip()
root = os.path.realpath(root)
fd = os.open(root, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
try:
    for part in (".codex", "hooks"):
        child = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
        os.close(fd)
        fd = child
    child = os.open("guard.py", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=fd)
    with os.fdopen(child, "rb") as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_size > 131072:
            raise RuntimeError("Hook script is not a bounded regular file")
        source = stream.read(131073)
finally:
    os.close(fd)
if hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() != expected:
    raise RuntimeError("Hook script hash changed; review definition and native hook trust")
exec(compile(source, root + "/.codex/hooks/guard.py", "exec"), {"__name__":"__main__", "__file__":root + "/.codex/hooks/guard.py"})
'
